rebaseline_history.reviewed_by: owner ruling "c a and b, re pin it again", after blind-review investigation
what_changed: scanner: several fixes landed since the 2026-08-10 baseline (F-1 sk_live_ prefix detection, fail-closed scan scope, config-file drop disclosure, entropy keyword branch).
spec: the corpus harness now points at evals/security/corpus-spec.json, a RULE-ONLY spec, instead of security/audit-spec.json.
why_this_is_not_silent_drift: The corpus findings drift was investigated BEFORE this re-pin, on the owner's ruling. It was a harness-wiring fault, not a detection regression: security/audit-spec.json declares an include-list product scope whose roots are this engine repo's directories, so a corpus-relative path (positive/beacon-1.sh) matched no product_root and 13 of 14 fixtures were dropped before any rule ran — leaving 10 of 11 rules unverified against their own payloads.

Proof it was wiring and not dead rules: with the product scope removed, the SAME scanner and the SAME 11 rules reproduce the frozen baseline 14-for-14 with 0 missing and 0 new, and the negative corpus is still clean.
The fix routes the corpus self-test at the rule-only spec, so the corpus tests the RULES while the release scan keeps the include-list scope that is correct for it.
Corpus findings count is therefore UNCHANGED by this re-pin: 14 positive, 0 negative. Only the two file hashes move.
admitted_cost: The corpus harness no longer verifies that the release spec's product scope admits the corpus. That policy is the release scan's job and is tested there.
The release spec security/audit-spec.json is no longer hash-pinned by the corpus harness at all. If it needs a pin, it needs its own gate.

rebaseline_history.reason: Blind run 13 fixes changed both pinned inputs. (1) INJ-SECRET gained npm_ registry tokens and the _authToken= form, because the root-file scope fix made a root .npmrc reachable and it then matched no rule — a scope fix alone would have moved the hole. (2) The scanner now redacts matched values from finding detail, so every baseline entry key changed. Findings count and rules are unchanged apart from the added INJ-SECRET alternatives.

Second regen in the same change: the redaction rule was narrowed from "mask the matched span" to "mask credential-shaped runs", which changed every detail key again. Final state of the blind-run-13 security fixes.
